children: RNS Number : 1946V  Pennpetro Energy PLC  17 September 2026

Pennpetro Energy plc (PPP), the company focused on developing strategic energy projects, announces that a recording of yesterday's shareholder call with management is available on the Company’s website.
To access the recording, click the link below:

The Company will host a further  shareholder call with management on 24 September 2026 at 18.30-19.30 UK time. To register for the meeting, please email ppp@camarco.co.uk. A recording of the call will also be available on the Company’s website.
SPARK Advisory Partners Limited - Financial Adviser
Jerry Keen, Head of Corporate Broking
